evidence.note: DC-CoT is a benchmark that isolates the effect of data augmentation, data selection and data mixing on chain-of-thought distillation into smaller student models, across teacher models, student models and reasoning domains.
evidence.title: The Quest for Efficient Reasoning: A Data-Centric Benchmark to CoT Distillation

evidence.note: PIR scores reasoning steps by their effect on answer confidence and prunes only low-importance verification/error-correction steps from distilled chain-of-thought data, producing models that reason more concisely without losing accuracy.
evidence.title: LIMOPro: Reasoning Refinement for Efficient and Effective Test-time Scaling
